client.business_model: Omnichannel retailer and distributor of Christian books, Bibles, gifts and homeschool resources, selling through a large e-commerce site, print catalogs and wholesale channels.
client.client_history: Founded in 1978 by the Hendrickson family, Christianbook has grown from a small mail-order operation into one of the largest global suppliers of Christian-focused books and related products, operating out of a 370,000-sq-ft headquarters in Peabody, Massachusetts.

revenue.notes: No official filing available. Third-party estimates range $53.4M–$84.2M. Used mid-range figure ($71M) but reliability is low.

locations.source: Company headquarters address in Agreement PDF and Google Maps listing
locations.notes: Only a single 370,000-sq-ft headquarters/distribution facility in Peabody, MA is referenced in all sources; no additional offices confirmed.

employees.source: TopWorkplaces.com (560 employees) corroborated by Wikipedia ("over 600" in 2019) and Leadiq (≈501 in 2025)
employees.notes: Estimates vary between 450–600. Selected 560 from TopWorkplaces (dated 2023) as the most specific recent figure.

extraction_sources: Agreement/Treya Procurement Cost Reduction Services Agreement Christianbook_v2.docx.pdf (pages 1-2)
Google Maps listing – Christianbook HQ, 140 Summit St, Peabody, MA
extraction_notes: Official legal name confirmed from signed services agreement ("Christianbook, LLC").
PE ownership: recapitalization by Nonantum Capital Partners noted by Accio.com and Rushtopress.org articles.
Revenue highly inconsistent across estimation sites; no audited figures available, hence low confidence.
Only a single physical facility is documented; company primarily operates online/catalog channels.
Employee count fluctuates in public sources; selected midpoint value and marked confidence as medium.
